checkpoint: hf hub lerobot/pi0 snapshot e4ed526af508e58f6008b29e9e48f1098278fdb5 (model.safetensors 14.01 GB fp32; PaliGemma-3B VLM + gemma-300m flow-matching action expert; loaded via PI0Policy.from_pretrained with a programmatically rebuilt PI0Config because the saved config.json uses deprecated draccus keys; all 777 tensors strict-loaded)

policy_input.observation.state: zeros(6) -- pi0's 6-d proprio space is an ALOHA/SO-100-class joint vector that cannot express our 20-d EE pose; zeros match the validated video probe and keep the identity normalizer in-distribution. Consequence: the policy is proprioceptively blind.
policy_input.task: request task string, tokenized by the saved preprocessor (paligemma-3b-pt-224, max_length 48)

adapter_spec.policy_output: predict_action_chunk -> [1,50,6] normalized actions (no dataset stats ship -> STATE/ACTION normalization is identity; outputs in normalized space)
adapter_spec.dxyz: dims 0:3 treated as per-step Cartesian velocity deltas x gain; cumulatively integrated onto the CURRENT measured left-EE xyz from `state` (receding horizon: each query re-anchors); dims 3,4 ignored (wrist joints, no EE analog)
adapter_spec.gain: auto-calibrated once on the FIRST real /act chunk (first 25 rows): gain = 6.5mm / median(|dxyz_raw|), clamped to [0.02, 1.0]. Measured: median|dxyz_raw|=0.0405 -> gain=0.1607 -> median commanded step 6.5 mm (task suggested ~0.2, target band 5-8 mm)
adapter_spec.gripper: dim 5 -> g = clip((a5 - lo)/(hi - lo), 0, 1), affine lo/hi calibrated with the gain as p5/p95 of the first real chunk (min span 0.02). Measured: [0.0202, 0.0402]
adapter_spec.rotation: left rot6d held at the current measured value for the whole chunk
adapter_spec.right_arm: rows echo measured state[10:20] verbatim (sim parks the right arm anyway)
adapter_spec.note: cross-embodiment adapter: pi0's joint-space output is reinterpreted as EE velocity -- no claim of semantic fidelity

infer_ms_per_query.note: server-side /act time on GB10 fp32 incl. jpeg decode + pre/post-processing (sim-side latency adds ~5 ms jpeg encode + transport; ep0 sim-side mean 660 ms, ep1 698 ms). Prior video probe measured 2550 ms cold.

notes: Honest zero-shot cross-embodiment result: the left arm wandered aggressively through the workspace (EE range up to 1.06 m in y, path length 3.8-5.0 m per episode), repeatedly commanded targets below/inside the table or outside the box (104+71 workspace clamps) and made 36+105 jump-limit hits; it never came closer than ~63-70 cm to the block and never touched it (block moved 0 mm, max lift 0 mm).
gripper channel switched between open/closed across chunks (grip_raw range -1.5..+1.0 normalized) but never in a useful grasp sequence; ep0 ended fully closed, ep1 fully open.

Failure modes expected: (a) pi0 is trained on ALOHA/SO-100 joint trajectories, not EE pose chunks -- dims 0:3 are joints we reinterpret as Cartesian deltas; (b) proprioception is zeros(6), so the policy cannot see where the arm actually is; (c) single forward pass per query, no history -- the model has no temporal context of its own flailing; (d) camera semantics differ (our mast/wrist cams vs ALOHA rig).

Same class of result as the smolvla_base flail precedent: the closed loop, contract, safety clamps and adapter all worked correctly; the zero-shot policy simply has no transferable skill for this cell.
